title: pkix-chain missing re-export of pkix_path_builder
description:
pkix-chain/src/lib.rs exposes Error::PathBuild(pkix_path_builder::Error) in its public API (line 233) but does not re-export pkix_path_builder. Callers matching on this variant must add pkix-path-builder as a direct dependency.

Location: pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:233
Recommendation: Add pub use pkix_path_builder; to pkix-chain's public API.
